scope: existing private team product workspace; personal workspaces report not-configured

routes.GET /v1/product/team-controls: team member read; returns current revision and bounded controls, or not-configured
routes.POST /v1/product/team-controls/preview: team admin; raw XLSX body (maximum 2 MiB); effects-free sheet/header/row/issues preview and source SHA-256
routes.POST /v1/product/team-controls/compare: team admin; JSON {expectedRevision, sourceSHA256, sheet, columns, workbookBase64}; effects-free complete row validation and added/changed/removed IDs with diffDigest
routes.POST /v1/product/team-controls/import: team admin; JSON {expectedRevision, idempotencyKey, sourceSHA256, sheet, columns, workbookBase64, expectedDiffDigest}; repeat exact workbook bytes and reviewed mapping/diff; CAS; returns new immutable revision
routes.GET /v1/product/projects/{id}/control-as: project read; current saved assessment and library freshness
routes.POST /v1/product/projects/{id}/control-a: project edit; JSON {expectedRevision, libraryRevision, libraryDigest, idempotencyKey, results:[{controlId,status,evidenceRefs,note}]}; CAS, no inferred compliance
project edit; JSON {assessmentRevision,target,summary}; durable reviewed amendment proposal, never auto-applied

project edit; JSON {expectedAssessmentRevision,expectedContextDigest,expectedTargetRevision}; explicit CAS applies the saved proposal to a new Discover/Design draft using existing review revocation and history, never approves it

control.source: sheet name, row number and preserved unknown column values

trust: No macro, external link, formula or hyperlink is executed. A preview never writes. An assessment is a reviewer record, not a compliance or delivery claim.
